requirementsBeforeAnyNewPaidVersion: Review the all-turn saved audit export, including successes, partial batches and unmatched receipts.
Freeze relevance ontology and task binding separately; define keep/set/clear/use_current semantics and unsupported cases.
Document signed-operation versus absolute-metric amount semantics, inclusive/exclusive thresholds and mixed-operation treatment.
Freeze code/prompt/schema/resolver/price versions and the provider-supported sampling configuration; do not infer pinning from an alias.
Specify independent repetition IDs, a cumulative incremental budget within the existing 45 RUB cap, and stop rules before dispatch.
Run backend interaction and privacy invariants, then the same frozen development matrix across the candidate configuration.
Evaluate the existing 96 seen regression turns and a fresh held-out acceptance split with no intervening prompt edits.
Report relevance, task binding, plan field accuracy, clarification coverage, end-to-end finance/answer correctness, tokens and latency separately.
stopPolicy: Any new unknown usage retains its full reserve and stops dispatch.
Any critical ownership/scope/money error blocks model acceptance.
A failed fixed experiment triggers root-cause review, not another prompt tweak against the last failing question.
Completed replay is never counted as an independent model repeat.
limitations: This file is an audit checklist, not an implemented paid experiment or a claim of model accuracy.
The CLI currently rejects all paid historical actions before keys, state or locks are accessed.
